title: personal-llm-inference-mini-sheet-ethan-2026
content:
Mini experiment tracker (personal) - quick reference for perf/cost tuning experiments

Columns: exp_id | date | model | quant | batch | seq_len | p50_ms | p95_ms | tps (tokens/sec) | est_cost_per_1M_tokens | notes | status

EXP-001 | 2026-02-03 | llama-3-8b | int8 | 8 | 512 | 110 | 230 | 480 | $0.60 | baseline, no KV cache, cold start included | done
EXP-002 | 2026-02-05 | llama-3-8b | int8 | 16 | 256 | 95 | 180 | 860 | $0.42 | enable prefix KV cache (local cache hit ~60%), throughput up, latency down | in_review
EXP-003 | 2026-02-11 | mixtral-8x7b | q4_0 | 8 | 1024 | 250 | 520 | 300 | $0.35 | high seq-length; kernel selection weird above 768, need re-run with KV split | draft
EXP-004 | 2026-02-14 | revchat-13b | int8 | 4 | 2048 | 420 | 980 | 110 | $1.10 | memory pressure, OOM on single GPU with batch>4, try 2xGC or model shard | draft
EXP-005 | 2026-02-20 | llama-3-8b | int8 + actorder | 12 | 512 | 88 | 170 | 920 | $0.38 | quant tweak improved p50; investigate p95 tail (spikes on concurrent requests) | in_review
EXP-006 | 2026-02-25 | gpt-4o-mini | fp16 | 2 | 128 | 45 | 80 | 2000 | $2.50 | toy test, cheap tokens but not equivalent quality; include eval prompts next | draft

Notes to self:
- Measurement methodology: p50/p95 measured from client-side synthetic load using wrk2 with constant rate; TPS measured as tokens generated per second aggregated over steady-state window. Include warmup of 30s.
- Cost calc: rough using infra unit prices + token compute estimate. Need to align with finance per-token metric (ask @Aisha).
- Observed 95p spikes correlate with garbage collection events on node pool (check SRE logs around timestamps).
- For EXP-003: kernel selector falls back to slower matmul on sequence >768. TODO: open issue & link PR to kernel tuning.

Quick TODOs:
- [ ] Re-run EXP-003 with KV split and smaller chunk size (target 768 boundary)
- [ ] Add eval set of 50 prompts to compare quality vs gpt-4 baseline (see GH PR #3421)
- [ ] Sync with SRE about autoscaler config that caused GC spikes on 2026-02-18
- [ ] Add cost breakdown column (infra vs model compute) to next iteration

Random bits / scratchpad:
- Local notes: when using batch>=16 observed slight decrease in p95 but increased p50 for short queries (micro-batching effect)
- Hypothesis: small prompts benefit from batching more than long prompts; need per-prompt-length split in next run
- Slack thread with Liam has perf traces: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01ABCDEF/p1676001234567890

History/refs:
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/3421 (kv-cache plumbing + metrics)
- JIRA: INF-1287 (investigate p95 GC spike)

End of sheet. Keep minimal; will port cleaned-up table to Confluence once stable metrics collected.
